references.text: The testimony that God gave Moses was placed in the ark, just as the Book of the Law was to be set beside the Ark of the Covenant as a witness.
The instruction to place the testimony in the ark relates to the positioning of the Book of the Law beside the ark as a witness against the people.
Moses placed the testimony in the ark, which is connected to the placement of the Book of the Law beside the Ark of the Covenant.
Joshua wrote these words in the Book of God's Law and set up a stone as a witness, paralleling the Book of the Law as a witness beside the Ark of the Covenant.
There was nothing in the ark except the two stone tablets, confirming that the Book of the Law was placed beside the ark, not inside it.
The discovery of the Book of the Law in the temple refers to the same Book of the Law that Moses commanded be placed beside the Ark of the Covenant.
Moses wrote down this law and gave it to the priests who carried the Lord's Ark of the Covenant, providing context for where the Book of the Law was placed.
The king was to copy the Book of the Law, referring to the same Book of the Law that was placed beside the Ark of the Covenant.
The Ark of the Covenant and its contents are described, including the tablets of the law, relating to the placement of the Book of the Law beside the ark.
